messages:
Maya (AE): Hi team — presales POC with EuroBank. They need a concise security/runbook note for their infosec: full picture of EU tenancy egress, sub-processors (are any outside EU?), cert management (rotation, BYO), and whether we can contractually prevent any cross-border egress unless they authorize it in writing. Also asking about pricing for any geo-replication or egress charges. Can infra/legal/ops confirm?
Lee (Solutions Eng): Quick Q: is this Hosted API only for POC or are they asking for Dedicated/Private options up front?
Maya (AE): Hosted for the POC, but they want a path to move to Dedicated if needed.
Ravi (Infra): Short summary: for EU tenants on Hosted, ingress and inference traffic is served from the EU region selected (e.g., eu-west-1 / eu-central-1). Client TLS terminates at regional edge; internal service-to-service traffic uses mutual TLS. Hosted doesn't support customer-uploaded client certs (BYO mTLS) today — that's available on Dedicated/Private. Sub-processors commonly in the path: regional cloud providers (AWS/GCP EU zones), CDN partner (FastEdge EU POPs), metrics/logging provider (LogVault EU cluster). By default we aim to keep data in-region.
Ravi (Infra): Important caveats: 1) control-plane DNS queries and health checks may use global resolvers (no customer payloads, but IPs may fall outside EU) 2) background telemetry aggregation is routed to a centralized metrics plane in us-central for cross-region ops. We can enable EU-only metrics replication for a customer, but it requires pre-provisioning (typically 2–4 weeks) and additional monthly cost. 3) optional features (auto model fetchers, third-party connectors) may contact external registries outside EU unless disabled.
Elena (Customer Sec): EuroBank is strict about any third-party access. They want an explicit list of every sub-processor and whether EU-region instances are used for EU tenants. Can Legal/Infra produce a one-page attestation?
Nora (Legal): We can provide a Residency Addendum that: (a) warrants that inference payloads for EU tenants will remain hosted in EU-resident instances and EU sub-processor clusters where available; (b) enumerates exceptions (DNS, global auth services, emergency failover) and (c) requires a written change request and agreement before enabling any cross-border egress. Nora: I will draft addendum language with enumerated exceptions. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Alex (Sales Ops): Pricing & ops note: enabling EU-only metrics replication and locking telemetry to EU is an ops workstream. Recommend quoting as an "EU Residency pack": one-time onboarding ~€4k, and replication/egress add ~€0.025/GB/month (ballpark). If they want a Dedicated pin with BYO mTLS, add capacity reservation premium ~12% on top of committed spend. I'll get concrete numbers from finance but flagging now.
Lee (Solutions Eng): For the customer-facing runbook, Ravi — can you provide step-by-step actions we can paste? Keep it short and checklist-style for infosec.
Ravi (Infra): Runbook (copyable):
```
1) Customer signs Residency Addendum with exceptions enumerated
2) We enable EU-region tenant pin (provisioning window ~4 hours)
3) We toggle telemetry replication to EU-only (requires pre-provisioning, 14-30 calendar days)
4) Customer validates endpoints: api.eu.redwood.ai and metrics.eu.redwood.ai
5) Customer whitelists regional egress CIDR blocks we provide
6) Optional: migrate tenant to Dedicated for BYO mTLS and private cert rotation
7) Final: run acceptance tests (sample requests + infosec checklist) and sign-off
```
Ravi (Infra): I'll also export the sub-processor inventory with region flags and drop it here (will include service descriptions and whether EU-resident clusters are available).
Elena (Customer Sec): Also note cert rotation policy: can you confirm rotation interval and whether we support cert pinning/subjectAltName? EuroBank will ask.
Ravi (Infra): Hosted certs: we manage certs for the regional edge and rotate on a quarterly cadence (90 days) or on security need; SANs include customer tenant FQDNs we assign. Dedicated/Private: customers can upload their own TLS cert chain and we support scheduled rotation by upload or via ACME integration in private setups.
Nora (Legal): Contract note: we can commit to EU-only residency for inference payloads and EU sub-processor usage where the sub-processor offers EU-resident instances, with the Residency Addendum enumerating allowed minimal exceptions. For anything outside that scope we require a written change order. I'll add the change-order clause.
Alex (Sales Ops): I'll prepare a 1-page quote with three rows: Hosted + EU Residency pack, Hosted -> Dedicated migration path (capacity premium), and Private deployment estimate. Will attach cost breakdown and lead times.
deploy-bot: Healthcheck: regional egress scan completed for eu-west-1 — no known outbound leaks detected. :white_check_mark:
Lee (Solutions Eng): Next steps: Maya to send the runbook and expectations to EuroBank; Nora to provide draft Residency Addendum; Alex to attach preliminary quote; Ravi to attach sub-processor export.
Maya (AE): Thanks — I'll reply to EuroBank now with the runbook and timeline, and set expectation for Legal/Quote/subprocessor list follow-ups. :thumbsup:
